part1.title: Messy Room? Send AI One Photo (15-Minute Plan) #shorts
part1.description:
Don't know where to start cleaning? Send an AI chat one photo of your room and ask for a 15-minute plan, smallest steps first. Then send a new photo and ask what's next.
An original animated AI tip by zylo.

Follow for one AI trick a day.
